rationale: A is clearer and substantially more robust because it normalizes the textual board by removing formatting spaces before traversal, whereas B claims spaces are stripped but never performs that operation, so its coordinates and edge detection depend incorrectly on raw string layout. A also safely handles empty and uneven rows, avoids indexing row zero blindly, and keeps neighbor traversal compact without allocating a slice on every visited cell. Its helper naming and comments make the search straightforward despite minor unnecessary generality around variable row widths.
